body:
Notes:

Currently we trigger the initial navigation in a bootstrap listener. Angular does not wait for bootstrap listeners to complete.Moving the logic naively into an application listener will not work because the root component is not created at that point. So the router can successfully run `preactivation`, but cannot run `activation`. We can split `navigate` into `preactivate` and `activate. Run`preactivate`in an application listener and run`activate ` in a bootstrap listener.
Is this being address by anyone? More than 3 months and it's still happening :/

issue.title: [2.x only] fix(router): do not finish bootstrap until all the routes are resolved
